checks.descripcion: data.js exporta TITLE y por defecto de 4 a 8 fichas con id entero positivo sin repetir, name de 3 o más caracteres sin repetir y detail de texto
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import items, { TITLE } from './src/data.js'; assert.ok(typeof TITLE === 'string' && TITLE.trim() !== ''); assert.ok(Array.isArray(items) && items.length >= 4 && items.length <= 8); assert.ok(items.every((item) => Number.isInteger(item.id) && item.id > 0 && typeof item.name === 'string' && item.name.trim().length >= 3 && typeof item.detail === 'string' && item.detail.trim() !== '')); assert.equal(new Set(items.map(({ id }) => id)).size, items.length); assert.equal(new Set(items.map(({ name }) => name)).size, items.length);"

checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { buildUrl } from './src/logic.js'; const base = 'http://localhost:3000'; assert.equal(buildUrl(base, '/api/items'), base + '/api/items'); assert.equal(buildUrl(base, '/api/items', { search: 'sol', limit: 2 }), base + '/api/items?search=sol&limit=2'); assert.equal(buildUrl(base, '/api/items', { search: '', limit: undefined, page: null }), base + '/api/items'); assert.equal(buildUrl(base, '/api/items', { search: 'a b&c' }), base + '/api/items?search=a+b%26c'); assert.equal(buildUrl(base, '/api/items', { limit: 0 }), base + '/api/items?limit=0');"

checks.descripcion: requestJson hace un GET con Accept: application/json y una señal de cancelación, y devuelve el cuerpo JSON
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { requestJson } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { const calls = []; const realFetch = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = (url, options) => { calls.push(options); return realFetch(url, options); }; assert.deepEqual(await requestJson(api + '/api/items/2'), items[1]); assert.equal(calls.length, 1); const options = calls[0] ?? {}; assert.equal(options.method ?? 'GET', 'GET'); assert.equal(new Headers(options.headers).get('accept'), 'application/json'); assert.ok(options.signal instanceof AbortSignal); assert.equal(options.body, undefined); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: requestJson envía data como cuerpo JSON con Content-Type: application/json
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { requestJson } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { const calls = []; const realFetch = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = (url, options) => { calls.push(options); return realFetch(url, options); }; const created = await requestJson(api + '/api/items', { method: 'POST', data: { name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' } }); assert.deepEqual(created, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }); const headers = new Headers(calls[0].headers); assert.equal(calls[0].method, 'POST'); assert.equal(headers.get('content-type'), 'application/json'); assert.equal(headers.get('accept'), 'application/json'); assert.equal(calls[0].body, JSON.stringify({ name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' })); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: requestJson se rechaza con un HttpError con el status y el mensaje de la API (o statusText), y devuelve null con un 204
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { requestJson, HttpError } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { await assert.rejects(requestJson(api + '/api/items/99'), (error) => error instanceof HttpError && error.status === 404 && error.message === 'No existe la ficha 99'); await assert.rejects(requestJson(api + '/api/items', { method: 'POST', data: { name: 'Sin detalle' } }), (error) => error instanceof HttpError && error.status === 400 && error.message === 'La ficha necesita name y detail'); assert.equal(await requestJson(api + '/api/items/1', { method: 'DELETE' }), null); const realFetch = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = async () => new Response('Caído', { status: 503, statusText: 'Service Unavailable', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' } }); await assert.rejects(requestJson(api + '/api/items'), (error) => error instanceof HttpError && error.status === 503 && error.message === 'Service Unavailable'); globalThis.fetch = realFetch; } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: requestJson cancela la petición pasados timeoutMs con un TimeoutError, y espera si la API responde a tiempo
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { requestJson } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { const start = performance.now(); await assert.rejects(requestJson(api + '/api/items/1?delay=400', { timeoutMs: 100 }), { name: 'TimeoutError' }); assert.ok(performance.now() - start < 350); assert.deepEqual(await requestJson(api + '/api/items/1?delay=100'), items[0]); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: listItems pide /api/items con search y limit solo cuando tienen valor
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { listItems } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { assert.deepEqual(await listItems(api), items); assert.deepEqual(await listItems(api, { search: 'ALFA' }), [items[0], items[2]]); assert.deepEqual(await listItems(api, { search: 'alfa', limit: 1 }), [items[0]]); assert.deepEqual(await listItems(api, { search: '', limit: '' }), items); assert.deepEqual(await listItems(api, { search: 'zeta' }), []); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: getItem devuelve una ficha por su id o se rechaza con un 404
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { getItem } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { assert.deepEqual(await getItem(api, 3), items[2]); await assert.rejects(getItem(api, 42), { status: 404, message: 'No existe la ficha 42' }); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: createItem crea la ficha con POST y la devuelve con su id; sin detail se rechaza con un 400
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { createItem, getItem } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { const created = await createItem(api, { name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }); assert.deepEqual(created, { id: 4, name: 'Delta', detail: 'd' }); assert.deepEqual(await getItem(api, 4), created); await assert.rejects(createItem(api, { name: 'Épsilon' }), { status: 400, message: 'La ficha necesita name y detail' }); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: updateItem cambia solo los campos enviados con PATCH y devuelve la ficha actualizada
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { updateItem, getItem } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { const updated = await updateItem(api, 2, { detail: 'nuevo' }); assert.deepEqual(updated, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'nuevo' }); assert.deepEqual(await getItem(api, 2), updated); await assert.rejects(updateItem(api, 2, { name: ' ' }), { status: 400 }); await assert.rejects(updateItem(api, 42, { detail: 'x' }), { status: 404 }); } finally { await server.close(); }"

checks.descripcion: deleteItem borra con DELETE y da null; la ficha deja de existir
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { startServer } from '{semana}/3-proyecto/starter/server.js'; import { deleteItem, getItem, listItems } from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ id: 1, name: 'Alfa', detail: 'a' }, { id: 2, name: 'Beta', detail: 'b' }, { id: 3, name: 'Alfabeto', detail: 'c' }]; const server = await startServer({ items }); const api = server.url; try { assert.equal(await deleteItem(api, 1), null); await assert.rejects(getItem(api, 1), { status: 404 }); assert.equal((await listItems(api)).length, 2); await assert.rejects(deleteItem(api, 1), { status: 404, message: 'No existe la ficha 1' }); } finally { await server.close(); }"
